WITH patient_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    ID,
    AVG(PIC) as avg_pic,
    AVG(HGB) / AVG(HCT) as ratio
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
overall_avg_ratio AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) as overall_ratio
  FROM patient_stats
),
filtered_patients AS (
  SELECT ps.ID, ps.avg_pic, ps.ratio, oar.overall_ratio
  FROM patient_stats ps
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_ratio oar
  WHERE ps.ratio > oar.overall_ratio
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_pic) as avg_of_avg_pic,
  AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(ratio - overall_ratio) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_patients
